name: A three-step caption cycles over a result card
looks: A single result card sits mid-frame, a generated image with its prompt and source thumbnails below it, while beside it a short caption builds line by line ("See it.", "Copy it.", "Make it yours.") each line arriving as the card's button state visibly changes (hover, then a "Copied" confirmation).
build: Caption lines fade/lift in one at a time (`y:8px -> 0`, ~200ms), each synced to the card's own state change: cursor hover scaling the card slightly, button label swapping to its confirmed state exactly as the matching caption line lands.
sound: A light tick on each caption line, a soft confirm chime exactly on the button's state change.
prompt: Beside a single result card showing its own source and output, build a short caption line by line, each new line landing exactly as a visible change happens on the card itself (a hover, a button confirming an action), so the words and the interface narrate the same moment together.
